 Follow Brad Pitt's girlfriend Ines turns heads in daring cut-out gown on glamorous date night
 Faye James Tue, November 17, 2026 at 4:27 AM UTC 3 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Brad Pitt and Ines de Ramon (Getty) Ines de Ramon looked radiant as she joined boyfriend Brad Pitt for a glamorous red-carpet date night.
 The jewellery executive stole the spotlight in a plunging ivory gown as the couple attended the Los Angeles premiere of The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth on November 16.
 Holding hands as they posed for photographers, Ines smiled broadly beside the actor, 62, who complemented her romantic evening look with dark tailoring and tinted glasses.
 Ines de Ramon's daring cut-out dress
 The pair smiled as they posed for photographers (@ Getty)
 Ines's floor-length gown featured delicate straps and a deep V-neckline, with gathered fabric crossing over her waist to create striking cut-outs at either side.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The softly textured dress fitted closely through the hips before widening into a skirt finished with tiers of delicate ruffles.
 Semi-sheer sections added another detail to the ivory design, while its sweeping hem concealed her shoes.
 Ines wore her long brunette hair in loose waves, with a centre parting framing her face. Sparkling drop earrings, softly defined eyes and glossy rose lipstick completed her look.
 A dark manicure added a contrasting finishing touch as she clasped Brad's hand on the carpet.
 Brad Pitt and Ines de Ramon's red-carpet date
 The jewellery executive stole the spotlight in a plunging ivory gown (@ Getty)

 Brad opted for a navy crew-neck knit beneath a long, double-breasted coat, teamed with coordinating trousers and dark brown boots.
 Advertisement Advertisement He accessorised with a fine gold chain and oversized, gold-framed glasses with lightly tinted lenses, wearing his hair swept back.
 The couple stood close together for photographs against the film's gold-lettered backdrop, with Ines appearing relaxed as they moved between poses.
 The couple at the 2026 Albies, hosted by The Clooney Foundation for Justice (@ Getty Images for The Clooney Fou)
 The premiere celebrates Brad's return as Cliff Booth, the character that earned him an Oscar for Once Upon a Time… in Hollywood .
 Directed by David Fincher from a screenplay by Quentin Tarantino, the follow-up moves the story to 1977. It opens in IMAX cinemas on November 25 before arriving on Netflix on December 23.
 Brad Pitt's relationship with Ines de Ramon
 Ines and Brad attend the "Heart Of The Beast" screening (@ WireImage)
 Brad and Ines were first publicly linked in November 2022, when they attended a Bono concert in Los Angeles.
 Advertisement Advertisement They subsequently appeared together at the British Grand Prix in July 2024, before making their red-carpet debut at the Venice Film Festival premiere of Wolfs that September.
 Although they have continued to attend events together, Brad has offered relatively few public comments about their romance.
 During a May 2025 interview with GQ, he dismissed the suggestion that their appearance at the British Grand Prix had been deliberately timed around his racing film, F1 .
 "No, dude, it's not that calculated," he said. His explanation for their increasingly public relationship was simple: "No, life just evolves. Relationships evolve."
